semantics.function: Both outputs select b when sel_b1 and sel_b2 are both 1; otherwise select a.
semantics.out_always_implementation: combinational procedural if statement with else
semantics.timing: Combinational; outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling; no clock or cycle latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement.
semantics.transactions: No handshake; inputs may change freely.

numeric.selection: Logical conjunction of the two one-bit select inputs
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation or overflow.

verification.oracle: Independent binary truth-table selection: select b for selector pair 11, select a for selector pairs 00, 01, 10.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 16 binary combinations of a, b, sel_b1, sel_b2; traverse forward and backward to check input changes and absence of retained outputs.
verification.comparison: Check each output against expected using case inequality after settling.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 compile with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite timeout for each.
verification.static_review: Exact module and ports; continuous assign; complete procedural if/else; no storage or nonsynthesizable DUT constructs.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z inputs is not specified; functional verification covers binary inputs only.
